dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Purposes are described in the model adaptation setting: healthy-only datasets are used to estimate the reference normative model; clinical datasets are used to recalibrate and then test on remaining healthy participants and patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we first use a linear homoscedastic model to estimate the parameters of the reference normative model on datasets with only healthy participants (ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI, FCON, HCP, HCPAG, HCPDV, IXI, NKI OPN, PNC, and UKBB). Then, in each run 50% of random healthy participants in clinical datasets, including CNP, HCPEP, OASIS3, and TOP are used to recalibrate the parameters of the reference model. The rest of the healthy participants and patients are used as test samples."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Kia2022.pdf.md: Experimental materials and setups / Model adaptation setting
